offset_convention: Zero-based Unicode code-point offsets, end-exclusive. All task characters happen to be ASCII. Removed spans partition all unselected raw text, including original separators; separators are reintroduced by serialization.
token_count_method: Whitespace-delimited tokens via Python str.split(); descriptive counts only, not model or production-ranking tokenizer counts.

effort.process: One fresh authoring pass for six tasks followed by programmatic offset, coverage, serialization and identity assertions. No retrieval, catalog searches, scoring or outcome-driven revisions.

Thanks.
